policies: Invalid provider, version, duplicate identity, missing result, timeout or runtime error rejects generation; never silently reuse a previous success.
Preload and dry scan create no chance opportunity and exclude external-condition entries from disposable scan copies.
Confirmed scan uses current state; chance is settled once per history/trigger/book/uid opportunity. Misses persist. Reload and inherited same-history branch do not reroll.
Eligible copies become constant for native selection with native probability disabled; stored entry remains condition mode. Native filters, budget, order, positions and delays remain in force.
All four source arrays are gated after local preset projection. Denied entries cannot seed native recursion, sticky or forced activation. A late bypass aborts sending.
Gate receipt counts successful condition opportunities, not final injections. Cancellation or budget rejection does not refund a settled opportunity.
Entry edit explicitly acknowledges ruleVersion; changing an unrelated title never silently repins it.
No remote service or model is called by condition evaluation. The adapter does not receive private current values. Private predicates cannot open public worldbook gates.
verified: verbatim APK native scan with isolated dependencies
